blurb: Northshore WaterSport Rentals offers self-service rentals of kayaks, paddleboards, double kayaks, and bicycles near Tempe Town Lake Marina. Customers book online, receive a code to access the storage locker, and return equipment in the same condition. Life jackets and helmets are included with rentals.
extraNote: All bookings may be canceled if the weather becomes unsafe · 24-hour advanced notice for cancellation requested but not strictly enforced · West side of the Vela Apartment complex, bottom floor, near Tempe Town Lake Marina boat dock
